Sample Leave Policy

Last updated: September 11, 2026

Vacation leave

Full-time civil service employees earn vacation leave each month. Vacation must be approved by the supervisor in advance.

  • Accrual begins on the first day of employment.
  • Unused vacation may be carried over up to the maximum.

Payout at separation

Unused vacation up to the maximum accumulation is paid at separation according to University policy.

Sick leave

Sick leave may be used for personal illness, medical appointments and the care of family members as defined in policy.
